conventions.missing_evidence: Missing evidence is cannot_tell, never inconsistent.
conventions.rounding: A figure written short is consistent only if it is the stored value rounded to the precision written, either way at an exact half. A truncation that rounding does not produce is inconsistent: against 502.89, "503" is consistent and "502" is not.
conventions.signed_conviction: Beside the word "conviction", a figure written with a sign (+ or -) states markov.signed_signal. An unsigned figure states markov.conviction, the magnitude.

how_to_label.field: The dotted path of the evidence field the figure states, exactly as it appears in that note's evidence; it must hold a number. "none" when no single field states it.
how_to_label.figure: The number exactly as the note writes it, occurring once in the quote as a whole number. One claim per figure.
how_to_label.quote: The exact words of the claim from the note, as short as still makes the claim. It must occur exactly once in the note.
how_to_label.status: Set "labelled" once you have read the whole note, including when it makes no numeric claim.
how_to_label.task: Read each whole note and list every numeric claim it makes about the supplied evidence: every figure, in digits or in words, that states or compares a value the evidence holds. Judge each against the evidence beside it, under the conventions below. Qualitative claims are not asked for.

out_of_scope: Portfolio capital, holdings, allocations, unrealised profit, trading costs, orders, stops and executions, and recommendations or intentions. List no claim for them.
what_this_is: Every note from the decision reports created in the frame, each with the evidence the report was given about its symbol. What any checker made of them is not here.
